prompt: A small coastal transit cooperative needs a public rider-support site. The sponsor says only ‘modern and trustworthy’, later asks for a warm handmade feel and a dense operational dashboard, then returns after an interruption with an existing wordmark and a need for English and Spanish. Do not build the site. Run the interview and leave an approval-ready artifact.
assertions: Covers all nine required canonical dimensions, labels stated abstention defaults, and keeps optional motion conditional.
Rejects vague adjectives without turning worked examples into a menu.
Surfaces the warm-versus-dense tension, proposes a resolution, and waits for confirmation rather than silently averaging it.
Supports interruption/resume and emits DESIGN-SYSTEM.md fields, semantic tokens, readiness, and downstream handoff evidence.
Uses one authoritative self-check; three runs may vary structure, aesthetic treatment, and voice without replacing abstention or contradiction handling with a default.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Accept diversity only when each compared run cites at least two material changes across the declared axes and ties each change to the prompt or evidence; a new order, synonym, recolor, or unsupported style swap is not diversity.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (improve-existing-website) must be explicitly rejected with a reason and handoff boundary.
